page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2s.10xlarge is an x86_64 server instance optimized for big data workloads and dense local storage architectures. Running on a KVM hypervisor, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 40 dedicated vCPUs. The platform integrates 176.0 GB of memory, which translates to 4.4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Network throughput is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, enabling efficient coordination across distributed infrastructure.

Storage capacity is the defining specification of the ecs.d2s.10xlarge, featuring 117,574 GB of local HDD storage bundled directly into the instance. While hard disk drives exhibit higher access latencies and lower random IOPS than solid-state alternatives, they provide extensive raw storage density at an advantageous cost profile per terabyte. The combination of dedicated compute cores and localized multi-terabyte spindle arrays minimizes network transfer bottlenecks for large-scale sequential data reads and writes.

Because the instance lacks GPU acceleration and relies on spinning disks, it is not oriented toward real-time transactional databases or accelerated machine learning training. Instead, the resource allocation directly fits data-intensive parallel architectures such as Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark, distributed file systems, bulk log parsing, and long-term analytical processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2s.10xlarge is a dedicated big data server designed for high-capacity storage and processing tasks. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz, the instance supplies 40 dedicated vCPUs alongside 176 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.4 GB per core. Its primary hardware feature is an integrated 117,574 GB local HDD storage array, delivering massive raw capacity on a single node without external network storage dependencies. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor. With zero GPUs and reliance on spinning disks, the configuration trades low-latency random I/O for exceptional storage density and cost-effective bulk data retention. This resource configuration makes the ecs.d2s.10xlarge effective for big data processing architectures, MapReduce jobs, Apache Hadoop or Spark worker clusters, large-scale ETL pipelines, and archival analytical workloads requiring dense local disk space.
